title: Shinonome Ena — A Shadow Out Of Sight〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: I have some free time since I don't have cram school today. Wanna go hang out somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Then, wanna check out that new shop that opened up by the station? I've been meaning to go.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Looks like everyone's going home... But where's Mafuyu...?)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Days when we don't have club are so boring. I never have anything to do at home.

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
What do you mean?
You could do your homework or work on something else, right?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
I thought Asahina was your hero.
Doesn't that mean you should be giving your studies the same attention you give club?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Those girls. Does that mean they're...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Um, excuse me.
Do you happen to know Mafu... Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Huh? Um... We're in the archery club together...

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Hey...!
You shouldn't be telling strangers that!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
If you don't mind me asking...
You don't look like you go to this school. What is she to you?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Whoa, up go the shields...!
But I can't really blame them...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Um, I'm sorry.
The thing is...
Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, hello.
I wasn't expecting to see you here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Airi! Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Hinomori?!
Do you know this person?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, she's my friend.

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
O-Oh, I didn't know.
Then, that must mean Asahina's also...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think you get the picture.
So, do any of you know if she's still at school?

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Um... We haven't actually seen her today since we didn't have club...

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Which means she probably left already.
She usually has to go home to study whenever we don't have archery club...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm sorry for scaring you two like that. And thank you for answering.

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: No, we apologize for reacting the way we did. Thank you two as well, Hinomori, Momoi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course. Please get home safe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, Ena, you were looking for Asahina...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah...
There was something I wanted to ask her...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait a second!
Did either of you two talk to her today?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, not me...
We weren't actually at school in the morning because of a meeting for work...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I haven't seen her today either...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (As much as I want to ask them about her phone or how she is... I don't want them to worry needlessly...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks, you two.
I need to get going now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure.
We were just about to head to the studio for practice anyway.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope we can chat again sometime, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If she's already on her way home, Mizuki might run into her at the station!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki! Any luck over there?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No, there's too many people. I'm never gonna find her here.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay...
I didn't find her over here either.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I tried asking some Miya Girls students about her just now, but they said she's already gone home.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Really...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Seriously, where is she? And why hasn't she tried to contact us...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I'll check the diner just in case.
There's a chance that she'll stop there before going home.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay, thanks!
I'll meet you there.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Got it!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Alright, I'm here. Our usual diner...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I'm not seeing Mafuyu anywhere...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Nor anyone else I recognize...
Did Mizuki start looking somewhere else already?)

<...na.
Ena.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Okay, no one will see here...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Len...? Is that you? Are you here?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Rin, you're with here too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah...
We came to tell you that the others found Mafuyu.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really?! Where is she?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<The park along her way home...
Miku and KAITO said they found her after finally managing to reach her phone.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay, then...
That's a relief...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<B-But...
Something else happened that's worrying us...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What?!
She's gonna tell her mom how she really feels...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That's what KAITO said...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was hoping that she would someday... Not right now...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Ena...
Kanade and Mizuki said they're gonna go home for now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
They are...?
Then, I guess I should too...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wait, Ena, what about school...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh... I left my bag at home, so I just won't go today...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I mean, I wouldn't be able to focus during class... Not with Mafuyu's problems on my mind...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Rin, Len, thanks for letting me know what's going on.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Um... We'll come back if we hear any further news.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Alright, I should head home...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I hope you actually go through with telling your mom how you really feel...)
